references.notes: The display has round, triangular and square towers, cream strip-fronted podiums and the adjacent railway platforms and canopies.
The evening photo shows all three plan forms, the fenced display pad and open views around the model railway.
The oblique aerial locates the display between the visitor entrance and the pond by the large parking lot. The two higher tower forms are clear and the smaller form overlaps in this view.

The 2022 drone footage fixes the approximate pad between the pool path and circular visitor plaza. The square tower is to the northeast of the triangular tower, with the model railway on the visitor-facing southeast side.

limitations: The model reconstructs the miniature installation in Latrun at about 1:25 scale. Exact roof and podium dimensions, small railway details and the as-built pad elevation are approximate.

The position and facing come from the drone frame, the north-up aerial view and PMTiles paths. The exhibit has no stand-alone mapped footprint. The current condition and operation of the miniature railway are unverified.
A small scene grade levels the raised pad in the default Earth viewer. Hosts with a different elevation datum, terrain profile or a coarse grid may need to provide a level pad at this position.

map.result: Drone frame and aerial controls locate the exhibit beside the mapped walking path. The proposed deck intersects no PMTiles building or water polygons.

fit.approximation: Align identifiable paths and plazas in the drone frame and inspect the overhead pad edge to set the signed heading.
